author: Vior_
body: I understand Zeusy that you denied me coming back, and yes. If I were you I would do the same. But I really have changed. Before I didn't understand anything about getting banned permantaly and I am truly sorry now. This is not a letter ignoring what you said before. I just want you to consider what you said. People can really change. Including me. So I request that you let me try to join back avicus, and if I      get banned once. For any reason. I will be kicked off the server for good no questions asked.

replies.body:
Hello,

My apologies, but this isn't how the server works. If you were banned for one reason, I would most likely either remove you punishment or reduce it, however you're currently banned for having excessive infractions, which shows us after 20+ infractions, you didn't learn. Thus, you will face the consequences like everybody else.  

Thanks!
